units.source_text: 千重子没想到真一会躺在那儿。

en.t: Chieko had not expected Shinichi to be lying there.

units.source_text: 在等候年轻的姑娘，却居然这样躺着。

en.t: He was waiting for a young girl, yet he was actually lying there like that.

units.source_text: 与其说他太不懂礼貌，使自己受到了侮辱，

en.t: It was not so much that he was terribly ill mannered and had insulted her,

units.source_text: 不如说自己讨厌真一那副睡相。

en.t: as that she disliked the way Shinichi looked while sleeping.

units.source_text: 在千重子的生活环境里，她看不惯男人躺倒的姿态。

en.t: In the world Chieko had grown up in, she was not used to seeing men sprawled out lying down.
